shortDefinition.en: In modern digital-camera usage, a camera without the SLR reflex viewing mechanism.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 在现代数码相机语境中，不采用单反反光取景机构的相机。

en: Mirrorless does not logically mean interchangeable-lens. MILC explicitly adds that condition; “微单” is market language, not another optical principle.
zh-cn: 无反不等于可换镜头，MILC 明确附加这一条件。“微单”是市场用语，不是另一种光学原理。

example.en: X-T5 has interchangeable lenses; GFX100RF has a built-in lens. Both use electronic viewing without a reflex mirror.
example.zh-cn: X-T5 可以换镜头，GFX100RF 使用一体式镜头，二者都通过没有反光取景镜的电子路径取景。

en: Modern digital mirrorless cameras generally display a sensor-derived image on an EVF or rear screen. “No mirror” alone is too broad to place every historical camera in that modern product category. Check lens attachment separately. A rangefinder-style silhouette does not establish coupled optical rangefinding.
MILC means Mirrorless Interchangeable-Lens Camera; unlike mirrorless alone, the full name explicitly states that the lens can be changed.
zh-cn: 现代数码无反通常通过 EVF 或后屏显示传感器画面，仅凭“没有反光镜”不能把所有历史相机都归入现代无反产品类别。镜头连接方式需单独检查；旁轴外形也不能证明存在联动光学测距器。
MILC 是 Mirrorless Interchangeable-Lens Camera 的缩写，即无反可换镜头相机；全称明确了镜头可换的条件。
